releases.notes:
- New Filters tab: global block filters that apply everywhere, on top of region filters
- Filter search finds words and parts of IDs and also suggests matching tags
- Picking a hue after a preset sets saturation, brightness and opacity to 100%
- `/sr plot` keeps already toggled regions visible

- Fixed broken `·` characters in 26.3 chat messages
- CI: source and docs checks, defaults and save/load tests, short failure summary

releases.notes:
## Fix

- Restricts transformed-model boundary handling to flat quads lying exactly on the region cut plane.
- Conquest Reforged extension toggles should now affect only the relevant two-dimensional face instead of coloring or culling the entire duplicated extension.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cepreni-pengwing/selective-render/compare/v1.8.8...v1.8.9

releases.notes:
## Highlights

- Applies Black and Culled boundaries after Fabric Renderer/Indium model transforms, including Conquest Reforged extension toggles translated outside their owning block.
- Debug boxes now outline all saved regions, including inactive and hidden presets, plus temporary PlotSquared regions.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cepreni-pengwing/selective-render/compare/v1.8.7...v1.8.8

releases.notes:
## Hotfix

- Fixed the Create/Flywheel startup crash introduced in 1.8.6.
- Flywheel compatibility now fails safely: unsupported future versions fall back to a full renderer reload instead of preventing Minecraft from starting.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cepreni-pengwing/selective-render/compare/v1.8.6...v1.8.7

releases.notes:
## Highlights

- Makes region visibility updates substantially smoother with Create/Flywheel by avoiding unnecessary full Minecraft renderer reloads.
- Adds a configurable full-reload threshold and default PlotSquared minimum Y value to the settings screen.
- Optionally keeps interaction filtering active while region rendering is off, while preserving vanilla no-op behavior by default.
- Supports Black and Culled boundary handling for model geometry extending beyond its owning block, including Conquest Reforged extension toggles.
- Uses the new smaller icon and removes the Codex contributor credit.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cepreni-pengwing/selective-render/compare/v1.8.5...v1.8.6
